The image shows a bowl of cubed honeydew melon with some red pieces, probably watermelon or tomato. The bowl is about 12–13 cm across and appears roughly 60% full of fruit. I estimate about 200 g of food.

Honeydew has about 36 kcal per 100 g and watermelon about 30 kcal per 100 g. A blend of roughly 75% honeydew and 25% red fruit comes to about 34 kcal per 100 g, so 200 g is about 68 kcal.
